text:
𝗦𝗟 𝟵𝟴 𝗔𝗟𝗟 𝗢𝗨𝗧! 🇵🇰🔥

Abbas 3/14, Razaullah 3/21, Aamer Jamal 3/24 bowled Sri Lanka out in 35.3 overs on Day 1 in Rawalpindi.
Kusal Mendis top-scored with 32.

Can SL fight back? 👇

#PAKvSL #Cricket

👉 Abbas 3/14, Razaullah 3/21, Aamer Jamal 3/24
👉 Kusal Mendis ka 32 sabse bada score raha

Kya SL wapas aa payegi? Comment karo 👇
